name: Girls on the Run Bay Area Junior Coach
org: Girls on the Run Bay Area
what_you_do: You coach elementary and middle school girls. The program covers running and life skills. You are a junior coach. You work 1.5 to 3 hours a week for 8 to 10 weeks.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 18 and in high school. The page says teens on Heart&Sole teams must identify as female, and males are welcome on Girls on the Run teams. Needs a completed reference, a signed waiver (parent signs if under 18) and the Junior Coach application. Background check at 18.
duration: 8 or 10 weeks, 1.5 to 3 hours per week. Spring 2027 starts the week of Feb 22 or March 8. The 5K is on Saturday, May 8.
deadline_text: The Spring 2027 Junior Coach application is open as of Nov 2, 2026. No deadline is posted. The season starts the week of March 8, with an early start the week of Feb 22.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Spring 2027 Junior Coach form. Questions: programs@gotrbayarea.org or (415) 863-8942.
notes: New Junior Coaches must finish online and in-person training before coaching. A parent or guardian must sign. Teams meet twice a week for 90 minutes.
